title: Moment bound for sign-valued functions
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, and let $f:\Omega\to\mathbb R$ take only the values $-1$ and $1$. For every real $p\ge 1$, the expectation of $|f-\mathbb E_\pi f|^p$ is at most $2^p$ times the expectation of $(f-\mathbb E_\pi f)^2$.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
